### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

What began with Edible Arrangements® in 1999 has evolved into a family of innovative brands under
the Edible Brands® umbrella. Today, we power a dynamic ecosystem of brands—each dedicated to helping
people savor life in every form.

and delicious baked treats to fresh-cut flowers and chocolate-dipped fruit platters, today's Edible®

80% of orders originate on Edible.com and are fulfilled by locally owned and operated stores across

as CEO since 2024.

## 25+ years of transforming brands

the beginning
2009 – 2018
2019 – 2022
2023 – 2025
the future
1999 to 2008: From Shop to System
* The first Edible Arrangements® store opens in East Haven, CT under the ownership of brand founder,
  Tariq Farid.
* Franchising begins; the first Edible Arrangements® franchise opens in Waltham, MA.
* Edible Arrangements® acquired and rebranded a supply-chain entity, now BerryDirect, which serves
  as the system-wide engine for sourcing, packaging, and fulfillment and enables scale into larger
  delivery networks.
* Edible Arrangements® made its first national TV debut on ESPN targeting men for Valentine’s.
* Edible Arrangements® launched an ahead-of-its-time website for online ordering via
  ediblearrangements.com, accepting internet orders for the first time and opening a new digital
  revenue channel.
* Founder Tariq Farid's goal to open 50 stores by 2005 was wildly surpassed when he opened the
  brand's 500th store powered by disciplined execution, engaged franchisees, and a repeatable
  playbook.
* Edible Arrangements® unveiled its gifting industry disruptive WOW Guarantee (now known as the
  Edible Guarantee), a 100% happiness promise: if an order is not perfect, we replace it or refund
  it.
2009 to 2018: Growth & Diversification
* Edible Arrangements® launched the first generation of the mobile app, another milestone in the
  brand’s convenience focus for customers.
* Edible Arrangements® announced the relocation of corporate HQ from Connecticut to Atlanta,
  Georgia.
* Edible Arrangements® scaled delivery capabilities, through BerryDirect, unlocking nationwide
  gifting for long distance customers and stronger connections.
* Edible Arrangements® opened its 1,000th store which was a defining moment in franchise expansion.
* Founder Tariq Farid partnered with external investors to accelerate the growth of Edible
  Arrangements®
2019 to 2022: Modernization Momentum
* Edible Arrangements® e-commerce and last-mile delivery capabilities accelerated, unlocking the
  ability to deliver to over 80% of US zip codes in under an hour.
* Edible Arrangements® launched new floral and baked goods categories that now account for nearly 20
  percent of the overall product portfolio, expanding the brand’s relevance and category reach.
* Edible Arrangements® Third-Party Channel partnership expanded to include DoorDash, Uber Eats,
  ezCater and more, turning the partnerships into multi-million-dollar revenue streams for our
  franchise system.
* Younger consumers increasingly chose Edible Arrangements® as a revamped media strategy,
  digital-first ordering, and new offerings reframed how they discovered the brand.
2023 to 2025: Building the House of Brands
* Tariq Farid consolidated ownership by buying out outside and family investors and created Edible
  Brands^{©} to grow a multi-brand portfolio.
* Somia Farid Silber, daughter of Founder and former CEO, Tariq Farid, became CEO of Edible
  Brands^{©} in October 2024, prioritizing platform-led growth, deeper personalization, and faster
  execution.
* Edible Arrangements® unveiled a modernized brand identity - refreshing the look and feel while
  honoring our roots and ushering in the next generation of Edible® .
* Edible Brands^{©} acquired the beloved restaurant concept, Roti Modern Mediterranean®, and
  announced plans for franchising to scale a health-forward fast-casual brand.
* Edible® opened its first next-generation retail store prototype in North Haven, CT, featuring a
  to-go café, bouquet bar, and open kitchen concept.
* Edible Brands^{©} announced the opening of new, non-traditional concepts for both Edible® & Roti®
  within Atlanta’s very own Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
* Edible® launched a new digital marketplace experience on Edible.com, expanding its product
  portfolio to include giftable, trending brands like Ghia, Bombas, Carbone, and more.
2026 & Beyond: Accelerating Into the Future
* Edible Brands^{©} will execute a strategic enterprise re-platforming initiative across key
  eCommerce, POS, and ERP systems to unlock faster scale and growth across the portfolio of brands.
* Roti Modern Mediterranean® is positioned for meaningful expansion in 2026, with strong momentum in
  franchise development and a healthy pipeline of new restaurant openings across both domestic and
  international markets. This sets the stage for sustained, multi-year unit growth and reinforces
  the brand’s long-term scalability.
* Edible® will launch a new, cutting-edge mobile app and loyalty program to further engage with both
  new and returning customers.
* The Edible Brands^{©} seasoned leadership team of industry veterans is aligned on disciplined
  growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation.
* Edible Brands^{©} continues to evaluate outside investment opportunities and complete
  transaction-readiness initiatives.

## our leadership

Our culture rewards curiosity, encourages innovation, and fosters a spirit of collaboration across
every level. We work as allies, listening, learning, and growing together, and we strive to be a
trusted partner to our franchisees, vendors, team members, and communities.

  playbook.
* Edible Arrangements® unveiled its gifting industry disruptive WOW Guarantee (now known as the
  Edible Guarantee), a 100% happiness promise: if an order is not perfect, we replace it or refund
  it.
2009 to 2018: Growth & Diversification
* Edible Arrangements® launched the first generation of the mobile app, another milestone in the
  brand’s convenience focus for customers.
* Edible Arrangements® announced the relocation of corporate HQ from Connecticut to Atlanta,
  Georgia.
* Edible Arrangements® scaled delivery capabilities, through BerryDirect, unlocking nationwide
  gifting for long distance customers and stronger connections.
* Edible Arrangements® opened its 1,000th store which was a defining moment in franchise expansion.
* Founder Tariq Farid partnered with external investors to accelerate the growth of Edible
  Arrangements®
2019 to 2022: Modernization Momentum
* Edible Arrangements® e-commerce and last-mile delivery capabilities accelerated, unlocking the
  ability to deliver to over 80% of US zip codes in under an hour.
* Edible Arrangements® launched new floral and baked goods categories that now account for nearly 20
  percent of the overall product portfolio, expanding the brand’s relevance and category reach.
* Edible Arrangements® Third-Party Channel partnership expanded to include DoorDash, Uber Eats,
  ezCater and more, turning the partnerships into multi-million-dollar revenue streams for our
  franchise system.
* Younger consumers increasingly chose Edible Arrangements® as a revamped media strategy,
  digital-first ordering, and new offerings reframed how they discovered the brand.
2023 to 2025: Building the House of Brands
* Tariq Farid consolidated ownership by buying out outside and family investors and created Edible
  Brands^{©} to grow a multi-brand portfolio.
* Somia Farid Silber, daughter of Founder and former CEO, Tariq Farid, became CEO of Edible
  Brands^{©} in October 2024, prioritizing platform-led growth, deeper personalization, and faster
  execution.
* Edible Arrangements® unveiled a modernized brand identity - refreshing the look and feel while
  honoring our roots and ushering in the next generation of Edible® .
* Edible Brands^{©} acquired the beloved restaurant concept, Roti Modern Mediterranean®, and
  announced plans for franchising to scale a health-forward fast-casual brand.
* Edible® opened its first next-generation retail store prototype in North Haven, CT, featuring a
  to-go café, bouquet bar, and open kitchen concept.
* Edible Brands^{©} announced the opening of new, non-traditional concepts for both Edible® & Roti®
  within Atlanta’s very own Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
* Edible® launched a new digital marketplace experience on Edible.com, expanding its product
  portfolio to include giftable, trending brands like Ghia, Bombas, Carbone, and more.
2026 & Beyond: Accelerating Into the Future
* Edible Brands^{©} will execute a strategic enterprise re-platforming initiative across key
  eCommerce, POS, and ERP systems to unlock faster scale and growth across the portfolio of brands.
* Roti Modern Mediterranean® is positioned for meaningful expansion in 2026, with strong momentum in
  franchise development and a healthy pipeline of new restaurant openings across both domestic and
  international markets. This sets the stage for sustained, multi-year unit growth and reinforces
  the brand’s long-term scalability.
* Edible® will launch a new, cutting-edge mobile app and loyalty program to further engage with both
  new and returning customers.
* The Edible Brands^{©} seasoned leadership team of industry veterans is aligned on disciplined
  growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation.
* Edible Brands^{©} continues to evaluate outside investment opportunities and complete
  transaction-readiness initiatives.

## our leadership

Our culture rewards curiosity, encourages innovation, and fosters a spirit of collaboration across
every level. We work as allies, listening, learning, and growing together, and we strive to be a
trusted partner to our franchisees, vendors, team members, and communities.

For over two hundred years, the Farmers’ Almanac has been a trusted companion through every season
of American life. First published in 1818, it has arrived faithfully, year after year, offering
time-tested wisdom on weather, gardening, and living well with nature. Few publications in history
can claim that kind of unbroken dedication to their readers — and fewer still have remained as
relevant, as loved, and as useful with every passing generation. Check frost dates, gardening
calendars, weather forecasts, moon phases, and seasonal advice.

Bio-refinery · Industrial Area, Nairobi

# East Africa's first *B100 biodiesel* refinery

Giloil converts used cooking oil into distilled, ISCC-certified B100 biodiesel — powering fleets,
industry and export across the region. Backed by three decades of oils and fats manufacturing:
edible oil refining, soap production and toll processing under one roof.

[Order Bulk Biodiesel][9] [Sell Us Your Used Cooking Oil][10]
B100 · DISTILLED FAME SPEC SHEET
Flash point**150 °C** vs 64 °C diesel
Sulphur content**≤ 0.001 %**
Carbon emissionsup to **−80 %**
Carbon monoxide≈ **−50 %**
Cetane rating**Higher** than petro-diesel
Certification**ISCC** · NEMA licensed
UCO IntakeNEMA-tracked collection
Pre-treatmentFiltration & degumming
TransesterificationOil → methyl esters
DistillationFuel-grade purity
B100 Biodiesel+ refined glycerine
What we manufacture

## One plant. Four businesses.

From waste-oil recovery to finished consumer products, Giloil runs an integrated oils and fats
operation in Nairobi's Industrial Area — flexible enough to process your feedstock, or supply you
finished product at scale.

Flagship · Division 01

### Biodiesel Manufacturing

The first and only commercial distilled B100 biodiesel plant in East, Central and Southern Africa.
Our bio-refinery converts 100% of incoming used cooking oil into fuel-grade biodiesel and marketable
by-products — built for flexibility, scaling as feedstock supply grows. Supplied in bulk for
transport fleets, industrial boilers, generators and export.

[Enquire about bulk supply →][11]
1st
Commercial B100 plant in E. Africa
100%
Of UCO feedstock converted
B100
Distilled, unblended fuel grade
ISCC
Certified sustainable production
Division 02

### Edible Oil Refining

One of the few refineries in the region properly equipped to refine both palm and soft oils, with an
in-house degumming facility. High-quality edible oils and cooking fats, refined to food-grade
standards at an affordable price.

[Discuss refining capacity →][12] Division 03

### Soap Manufacturing

Laundry and multipurpose soap produced on-site from our own refined oils and fats — closing the loop
between refining by-products and finished consumer goods, with consistent quality batch after batch.

[Request product list →][13] Division 04

### Toll Processing

Contract manufacturing on your terms. Bring your feedstock or your formulation — we refine, process
and pack under your brand using our plant, our chemists and our quality systems. You keep the
margin; we handle production.

[Get a toll processing quote →][14]
Used cooking oil collection

## Your waste oil has value. We collect it.

Giloil is a NEMA-approved used cooking oil collector and recycler. Hotels, restaurants and food
processors across Kenya get a compliant, documented disposal channel — and their waste comes back to
the road as clean fuel.
1. #### Scheduled or on-call collection
   
   Regular pre-arranged pickups, or collection within 24 hours of your request — with clean
   replacement jerricans left behind.
2. #### NEMA tracking document issued
   
   Every collection comes with official documentation, keeping your business fully compliant with
   Kenyan environmental law.
3. #### Converted at our bio-refinery
   
   Every drop is processed into distilled B100 biodiesel and useful by-products — nothing goes to
   waste or into the drains.
4. #### Collected by trucks running on your oil
   
   Our entire collection fleet runs on biodiesel made from the very oil it collects. The loop is
   real, and it's on the road.

[Book a Collection][15]
Why B100

## A better molecule for your engine — and the air

Biodiesel isn't just cleaner on paper. It's safer to store, kinder to engines, and dramatically
lighter on emissions than petroleum diesel.

150°C
Flash point — non-flammable and non-explosive in storage, vs 64 °C for petro-diesel.
−80%
Reduction in carbon emissions — the CO₂ released was already in the atmosphere.
>10%
Oxygen in the biodiesel molecule — cleaner combustion, visibly less soot.
0.001%
Maximum sulphur content, with superior lubricity that reduces engine wear.
Inside the plant

## See where it happens

From the B100 control room to the packing lines — a look inside our facilities on Gilgil Road,
Industrial Area.

# East Africa's first *B100 biodiesel* refinery

Giloil converts used cooking oil into distilled, ISCC-certified B100 biodiesel — powering fleets,
industry and export across the region. Backed by three decades of oils and fats manufacturing:
edible oil refining, soap production and toll processing under one roof.

[Order Bulk Biodiesel][9] [Sell Us Your Used Cooking Oil][10]
B100 · DISTILLED FAME SPEC SHEET
Flash point**150 °C** vs 64 °C diesel
Sulphur content**≤ 0.001 %**

Certification**ISCC** · NEMA licensed
UCO IntakeNEMA-tracked collection
Pre-treatmentFiltration & degumming
TransesterificationOil → methyl esters
DistillationFuel-grade purity
B100 Biodiesel+ refined glycerine
What we manufacture

## One plant. Four businesses.

From waste-oil recovery to finished consumer products, Giloil runs an integrated oils and fats
operation in Nairobi's Industrial Area — flexible enough to process your feedstock, or supply you
finished product at scale.

Flagship · Division 01

### Biodiesel Manufacturing

The first and only commercial distilled B100 biodiesel plant in East, Central and Southern Africa.
Our bio-refinery converts 100% of incoming used cooking oil into fuel-grade biodiesel and marketable
by-products — built for flexibility, scaling as feedstock supply grows. Supplied in bulk for
transport fleets, industrial boilers, generators and export.

[Enquire about bulk supply →][11]
1st
Commercial B100 plant in E. Africa
100%
Of UCO feedstock converted
B100
Distilled, unblended fuel grade
ISCC
Certified sustainable production
Division 02

### Edible Oil Refining

One of the few refineries in the region properly equipped to refine both palm and soft oils, with an
in-house degumming facility. High-quality edible oils and cooking fats, refined to food-grade
standards at an affordable price.

[Discuss refining capacity →][12] Division 03

### Soap Manufacturing

Laundry and multipurpose soap produced on-site from our own refined oils and fats — closing the loop
between refining by-products and finished consumer goods, with consistent quality batch after batch.

[Request product list →][13] Division 04

### Toll Processing

Contract manufacturing on your terms. Bring your feedstock or your formulation — we refine, process
and pack under your brand using our plant, our chemists and our quality systems. You keep the
margin; we handle production.

[Get a toll processing quote →][14]
Used cooking oil collection

## Your waste oil has value. We collect it.

Giloil is a NEMA-approved used cooking oil collector and recycler. Hotels, restaurants and food
processors across Kenya get a compliant, documented disposal channel — and their waste comes back to
the road as clean fuel.
1. #### Scheduled or on-call collection
   
   Regular pre-arranged pickups, or collection within 24 hours of your request — with clean
   replacement jerricans left behind.
2. #### NEMA tracking document issued
   
   Every collection comes with official documentation, keeping your business fully compliant with
   Kenyan environmental law.
3. #### Converted at our bio-refinery
   
   Every drop is processed into distilled B100 biodiesel and useful by-products — nothing goes to
   waste or into the drains.
4. #### Collected by trucks running on your oil
   
   Our entire collection fleet runs on biodiesel made from the very oil it collects. The loop is
   real, and it's on the road.

[Book a Collection][15]
Why B100

## A better molecule for your engine — and the air

Biodiesel isn't just cleaner on paper. It's safer to store, kinder to engines, and dramatically
lighter on emissions than petroleum diesel.

150°C
Flash point — non-flammable and non-explosive in storage, vs 64 °C for petro-diesel.
−80%
Reduction in carbon emissions — the CO₂ released was already in the atmosphere.
>10%
Oxygen in the biodiesel molecule — cleaner combustion, visibly less soot.
0.001%
Maximum sulphur content, with superior lubricity that reduces engine wear.
Inside the plant

[ FAQ ][131]


Q:

What is the MOQ?

A:

For standard stock products, there is no minimum order requirement. For special size and custom
products we support as less as possible minimum order quantity . Please consult our sales staff for
details.

Q:

Are you a manufacturer and trading company?

A:

We are an eco-friendly packaging direct manufacturer with 15 years of experience. We have our own R
& D team, production plant, sales team, We are good at product customization and various product
requirements. Our marketing office central located in Shenzhen China, the total area of the factory
is about 50,000 square meters in Dongguan, Guangdong Province and Jinhua, Zhejiang Province.

Q:

Do you support trial order for testing?

A:

It is welcome to place trial order for testing.

Q:

Which Payment terms you can offer?

A:

We accept most of payment terms, such as T/T, Western Union, Alibaba trade assurance, Paypal, LC,
OA.

IJCMAS is designed for the prompt publication of peer-reviewed articles in all areas of the subject.
The journal articles will be accessed freely online.

All manuscripts are pre-reviewed by the editor, and if appropriate, sent for blind peer review.
Contributions must be original, not previously or simultaneously published elsewhere, and are
critically reviewed before they are published. Manuscripts submitted to the IJCMAS are peer
reviewing, initially reviewed according to the flow diagram reviewing and then reach to the
technical reviewer [online notepad][61]. A minimum of three reviews related to subject is required
for each Journal manuscript. IJCMAS publishes original articles, short communications to editor and
reviews monthly.

IJCMAS is currently accepting manuscripts; you can support this journal (IJCMAS) by sending your
manuscripts to us at [editorijcmas@gmail.com][62]

A manuscript number will be emailed to the corresponding author within 48 hours.

## Aim & Scope

**International Journal of Current Microbiology and Applied Sciences** ISSN:2319-7692(Print),
ISSN:2319-7706(Online) is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed journal with reputable academics and
experts as members of its Editorial Board. The Current Microbiology aims to publish all the latest
and outstanding research articles. Review and letters in all areas of major importance to techniques
of microbiology and applied research with publishes high quality of review and research articles on
novel aspects of Microbiology including Environmental, Food, Agricultural, Medical, Pharmaceutical,
Veterinary, Soil, Water and Biodeterioration.

The Applied Sciences aims to publish Research articles in Biological Sciences, Biodiversity,
Biotechnology, Clinical Sciences, Agricultural Sciences, Chemical Sciences, and Environmental
Sciences.

IJCMAS is designed for the prompt publication of peer-reviewed articles in all areas of the subject.
The journal articles will be accessed freely online.

All manuscripts are pre-reviewed by the editor, and if appropriate, sent for blind peer review.
Contributions must be original, not previously or simultaneously published elsewhere, and are
critically reviewed before they are published. Manuscripts submitted to the IJCMAS are peer
reviewing, initially reviewed according to the flow diagram reviewing and then reach to the
technical reviewer [online notepad][61]. A minimum of three reviews related to subject is required
for each Journal manuscript. IJCMAS publishes original articles, short communications to editor and
reviews monthly.

IJCMAS is currently accepting manuscripts; you can support this journal (IJCMAS) by sending your
manuscripts to us at [editorijcmas@gmail.com][62]

A manuscript number will be emailed to the corresponding author within 48 hours.

## Providing Sustainable Pouch Packaging Solutions

[lankerpack sustainable packaging products]

[Sustainable packaging][72] entails the use of recyclable or compostable materials to produce
packaging products. It minimizes the exploitation of raw materials and helps to curb waste
pollution.

At Logos Pack, we are passionate about sustainability. We develop and create sustainable pouch
packaging using biodegradable and 100% recyclable materials. They are highly-effective,
eco-friendly, and best of all, sustainable.

Sustainable packaging is ideal for industries such as the retail and food sectors which require bulk
long-term supply of packaging. We have the capacity to keep up with such demand and are constantly
innovating to come up with even more sustainable packaging solutions.

[Know Our Sustainable Packaging][73]

## All-in-one Flexible Pouch Solution

[Custom Flexible Liquid Packaging][74]

Custom flexible liquid packaging offers great utility to consumers as it is leak-proof, not prone to
breakage, and makes products easy to store due to flexibility. Further, it keeps detergents,
cosmetics, and motor care products in prime condition for long shelf-lives.

[Custom Printed Food Packaging][79]

High-barrier flexible food pouches protect food from contaminants like bacteria and aeration which
accelerate perishability. Additionally, by maintaining optimal conditions, they preserve the flavor
of the food until consumers get to enjoy it. Other pouch benefits include temperature-resistance and
non-reactivity.

international certifications.

## 4 Steps of Navigating Your Custom Flexible Pouch Project
* #### Initiate your project
  
  Simply contact us with a detailed description of your desired custom flexible packaging including
  product type and any special features. Our team will respond within 24 hours.
* #### The template
  
  Our design team will suggest solutions and present to you design options as per the requirements
  you presented. You may also submit artwork or choose from our collection.
* #### Design Samples
  
  Once the design is ready we will send you a digital and a physical sample of your custom packaging
  for testing, approval, and or, any modification requests.
* #### Production and delivery
  
  After all design modifications have been made and you approve of the design, we will begin
  production. Your flexible packaging products will be delivered within 30 days.

**ABOUT NIMO PACKAGING**

NIMO PACKAGING is specialized in all kinds of cannabis packaging and accessories. Including child
resistant packaging, squeeze tubes, pre-roll packaging, child resistant glass and plastic bottles,
plastic bags, sorts of packaging for edibles and concentrates for your choice. The value proposition
of the NimoPackaging Group remains the same: To deliver high quality and safe products in a timely
manner with responsive customer service. We will continue to work around the clock (24/7) to offer
our customers a trustworthy "factory-direct" relationship, which will assure you that we, as your
cannabis packaging partner, are reliable and offer you a competitive price.
* Main Products
  
  Premium marijuana packaging for your cannabis business.
* Quality Assurance
  
  Pre-production sample before mass production, final Inspection before shipment; Maintained China
  Classification Society certifications for ISO9001.
* Experienced
  
  Nimo Group a company with 5 years experience of production and sales all over the world,consisting
  of Chinese factory and American company.

# Notpla
# Disappearing
# Packaging

[Pause video][Play video]

# Convenience doesn't have
# to cost the world

This simple food container is carefully engineered to eliminate waste and make the planet a
healthier place. Where conventional containers have petrol-based coatings that stick around forever,
this one has a 100% natural seaweed coating. Once finished, the whole package can be composted and
disappears without a trace—just like a fruit peel.
[more about Notpla Food Containers][14]

# Seaweed forever

There are forests below the sea that are very dear to us. Seaweed grows quickly, and needs no
freshwater, land or fertiliser. It captures carbon and makes the surrounding waters less acidic.

Beyond this, seaweed is abundantly available and has near-magical material properties. In the quest
to heal our ecosystems and food chains from the toxic waste of plastic packaging, it is the perfect
companion species and an integral partner to our solutions.
[more about Notpla's Impact Theory][15]

# The liquid packaging revolution

This is where it all began for Notpla.

Taking inspiration from nature, this innovative solution offers a sustainable alternative to
single-use plastic packaging. Its unique design allows the liquid to be encapsulated in a thin,
flexible layer that is 100% naturally biodegradable and entirely edible.
[more about Ooho][16]

# **Reinventing the coffee cup without plastic**

As part of a €4 million, three year Horizon Europe research project, Notpla is working to reinvent
one of the world’s most overlooked single use products.

Building on early pilots, including our Gen 1 espresso cup, the project brings together partners
across Europe and Africa to develop a high performance coffee cup with a fully natural coating that
does not rely on plastic.
[more about the Horizon Grant][17]

# Microplastics in food packaging: the hidden problem

Microplastics are now being detected across food systems, from water and seafood to human tissue.As
research evolves, attention is turning to how everyday materials, including packaging, may
contribute to exposure.
[read more][18]

# Applications for a new everyday

Our collection includes true solutions for packaging foods, drinks, care products, and many other
items you use every day. While some are edible, some compostable, and some dissolve in water — they
all disappear back into nature without any harmful traces.

industrial sectors. Practically any type of operation looking to automate its processes, increase
production, and reduce labor costs can benefit from choosing nVenia as their packaging automation
partner.

[
][142]

### [ VLA Model Open Mouth Bag Filling Machine ][143]

The VLA Open Mouth Bagging Machine uses an innovative axial bag movement to achieve bagging rates of
up to 17 bags per minute on pre-made open mouth bags.

[More Details][144]

[
][145]

### [ EXTREME XL Series L-Bar Air Shrink Wrap System ][146]

Our ARPAC Brand EXTREME XL models are workhorses in the industry, featuring a proprietary design
that provides fast, user-friendly and reliable operation.

[More Details][147]

[
][148]

### [ VPC Model Conventional Palletizer ][149]

nVenia’s VPC palletizing solution offers the quality and performance features demanded by the
industry. With user-friendly touch screen displays, adjusting patterns is effortless. Each layer is
meticulously stacked and compressed, ensuring the creation of a perfectly stable pallet.

[More Details][150]

[
][151]

### [ EXTREME XR Series Servo Shrink Wrap System ][152]

The ARPAC Brand EXTREME XR model is nVenia’s highest performance wrapping system, ideal for high
speed applications that require accurate and repeatable shrink seal quality.

[More Details][153]

# End-of-Line Packaging Solutions Focused on Quality, Durability and Innovation

nVenia brings Duravant packaging leaders Arpac, Fischbein, and Hamer Packaging together to create
next-level packaging equipment integration and innovation. One name, in one location, with one
shared focus: our customers and the problems they need to solve.

As your packaging machine suppliers, we can provide a wide range of primary, secondary, and
end-of-line packaging systems thanks to our many capabilities. Our expertise as packing machine
manufacturers includes conceptualizing, designing, manufacturing, installing, and integrating, and
servicing this equipment.

To learn more about what makes us a leader among primary and secondary packaging companies, [get in
touch with us today][140] or [request a quote][141].

## Featured Products

Our primary, secondary, and end-of-line packaging machinery can be found in the CPG, food, and
industrial sectors. Practically any type of operation looking to automate its processes, increase
production, and reduce labor costs can benefit from choosing nVenia as their packaging automation
partner.

nVenia’s VPC palletizing solution offers the quality and performance features demanded by the
industry. With user-friendly touch screen displays, adjusting patterns is effortless. Each layer is
meticulously stacked and compressed, ensuring the creation of a perfectly stable pallet.

[More Details][150]

### Frequently Asked Questions

All the relevant questions about custom boxes and packaging have been answered. If you still have
any other questions, contact us anytime by phone, chat, or via the contact form.

#### What is the minimum order taking time you need?

We strive to accommodate your order between 8 to 10 business days, but multiple factors are involved
in the process. Product line for which you need packaging
* Quantity of boxes
* Weather difficulties
* Design approval delays

#### How can I cancel my order?

A client-friendly order-canceling process is available for your convenience. Dial or email us within
48 hours of placing the order to stop further progress.

#### Do you offer an earth-friendly box range to your customers?

Absolutely, yes, no matter which packaging type you contact us for, you will experience
earth-friendly packaging material in every purchase. We take pride in our services, and this is one
of them; our consults acknowledge us for serving them sustainable options.

#### Which payment methods are acceptable?

You do not have to worry about it; all popular payment methods, Visa to Master card payment, Amex to
Discover, and PayPal, are acceptable.

#### How can I minimize my order cost?

We offer you boxes at wholesale price with a minimum order limit of 50 boxes. Plus, design and
material consultation and shipping all over the USA services automatically cut down the overall
cost. You can also contact a customer representative to enjoy custom packaging at the minimum
possible rate.

#### How much does it cost to make a custom-printed box?

It all depends on the printing technique and quality you use for boxes. We ensure one thing here:
whatever technique—onset, digital, or screen—you choose, the result will be top-notch. Contact our
printing specialist to learn more about printing methods that are cost-effective and best suited for
your chosen packaging material.

#### Do you get approval before sending boxes to production?

Our team will send you a design file for final approval. You can also ask for physical sampling for
better assessment. This is done to remove possible bugs in packaging design, material, and printing.
After the assessment process, production has started.

#### How is artwork added both inside and outside of the box?

Many customers find that adding or printing artwork inside the box as well as outside is an
appealing option. We can easily add artwork anywhere on your custom packaging, but the cost varies
depending on your requirements, so please ask about this before confirming your order.

### Frequently Asked Questions

All the relevant questions about custom boxes and packaging have been answered. If you still have
any other questions, contact us anytime by phone, chat, or via the contact form.

#### What is the minimum order taking time you need?

We strive to accommodate your order between 8 to 10 business days, but multiple factors are involved
in the process. Product line for which you need packaging
* Quantity of boxes
* Weather difficulties
* Design approval delays

#### How can I cancel my order?

A client-friendly order-canceling process is available for your convenience. Dial or email us within
48 hours of placing the order to stop further progress.

#### Do you offer an earth-friendly box range to your customers?

Absolutely, yes, no matter which packaging type you contact us for, you will experience
earth-friendly packaging material in every purchase. We take pride in our services, and this is one
of them; our consults acknowledge us for serving them sustainable options.

#### Which payment methods are acceptable?

You do not have to worry about it; all popular payment methods, Visa to Master card payment, Amex to
Discover, and PayPal, are acceptable.

#### How can I minimize my order cost?

We offer you boxes at wholesale price with a minimum order limit of 50 boxes. Plus, design and
material consultation and shipping all over the USA services automatically cut down the overall
cost. You can also contact a customer representative to enjoy custom packaging at the minimum
possible rate.

#### How much does it cost to make a custom-printed box?

It all depends on the printing technique and quality you use for boxes. We ensure one thing here:
whatever technique—onset, digital, or screen—you choose, the result will be top-notch. Contact our
printing specialist to learn more about printing methods that are cost-effective and best suited for
your chosen packaging material.

#### Do you get approval before sending boxes to production?

Our team will send you a design file for final approval. You can also ask for physical sampling for
better assessment. This is done to remove possible bugs in packaging design, material, and printing.
After the assessment process, production has started.

#### How is artwork added both inside and outside of the box?

Many customers find that adding or printing artwork inside the box as well as outside is an
appealing option. We can easily add artwork anywhere on your custom packaging, but the cost varies
depending on your requirements, so please ask about this before confirming your order.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## How can we help you?

How we can help you with Frequently Asked Questions.

##### What’s the Packaging design process?

At the Premier Custom Boxes, we collaborate with our clients. We treat them as partners and ensure
they receive a premier experience. Our design team crafts boxes that fulfill their business goals as
per their requirements. We carry out branding, customization, printing, and share templates with
them to get their feedback.

##### Do I need to pay any shipping costs for packaging boxes?

No. You won’t have to pay any delivery charges if you place an order in any state of the USA. Our
services cover the whole of the USA. We ship custom packaging boxes perfectly, so our clients pack
products and market them correctly.

##### Is there any minimum count of packaging boxes that I can order?

You can order a minimum of 100 packaging boxes from us. This facility also comes with the offset
printing option. Our team ensures smooth and frictionless delivery no matter the packaging
shipment’s size.

##### Can I order eco-friendly packaging boxes?

You can order environment-friendly packaging boxes from us. Businesses will have the facility to opt
for kraft cardstock because of its recyclable nature. These are bio-degradable and don’t harm our
natural habitat. We use sustainable raw materials in the production process that are pure and don’t
impact our surroundings.

##### What is your order processing time?

When you order packaging boxes or printing services, the team gets down to business. The turnaround
time is fast, and our team works tirelessly on the order’s processing. Within 10 to 12 working days,
we ship boxes to your doorstep. In some cases, businesses request instant delivery. So, we also have
a rapid delivery process through which we ship orders within a week.

##### Can I get a price quote for packaging boxes?

You can visit our website and go to the price quote section. You need to fill out a form and tell us
about your requirements. You need to select the packaging box type, cardstock, and quantity of boxes
required. There’s also a section where you will mention the box dimensions, and you can also give
special instructions. Our team will respond with a detailed price quote.

##### Do I have the option of Add-ons along with the packaging boxes?

There are numerous Add-on options, and you can get complete guidance from our packaging team. These
include custom inserts that come in various forms and colors. You can use them inside the packaging
to add grace and give extra cushion to items. Similarly, boxes with magnetic lids are available. You
can style them through finishing options like Spot UV, Glossy and Matte coating.

##### What payment methods are accepted?

We accept payment through MasterCard, Paypal, Visa, Discover Network, and American Express cards.
There is a secure SSL encrypted transaction, and your credit card details will remain confidential.

##### Should I pay extra for packaging design support?

No. You can consult our expert designers and get their valuable input without paying any cost. The
packaging design support service is free, and it comes with unlimited revisions. Professional
designers will guide you on the branding, styling, and appropriate printing of packaging.

##### What materials are used in the production of boxes?

We use top-notch raw materials in the manufacturing process. We craft packaging boxes with
cardboard, kraft, corrugated and rigid cardstock depending on the product’s nature. These are all
properly refined and pure, which adds more durability to boxes.

services. With years of experience, we are famous in the industry for our unique **custom boxes with
logo **of all types. We have a state-of-the-art printing press for digital and offset printing
services that give wonderful print quality. Our team has a wide array of design options for all

You can contact us for bespoke **custom made boxes** because we offer a huge variety of custom

Customization is the key to success, and we help you to personalize them in a way that can make your

Since we are available for our clients at affordable rates, you can access our team to meet the

## How can we help you?

How we can help you with Frequently Asked Questions.

##### What’s the Packaging design process?

At the Premier Custom Boxes, we collaborate with our clients. We treat them as partners and ensure
they receive a premier experience. Our design team crafts boxes that fulfill their business goals as
per their requirements. We carry out branding, customization, printing, and share templates with
them to get their feedback.

##### Do I need to pay any shipping costs for packaging boxes?

No. You won’t have to pay any delivery charges if you place an order in any state of the USA. Our
services cover the whole of the USA. We ship custom packaging boxes perfectly, so our clients pack
products and market them correctly.

##### Is there any minimum count of packaging boxes that I can order?

You can order a minimum of 100 packaging boxes from us. This facility also comes with the offset
printing option. Our team ensures smooth and frictionless delivery no matter the packaging
shipment’s size.

##### Can I order eco-friendly packaging boxes?

You can order environment-friendly packaging boxes from us. Businesses will have the facility to opt
for kraft cardstock because of its recyclable nature. These are bio-degradable and don’t harm our
natural habitat. We use sustainable raw materials in the production process that are pure and don’t
impact our surroundings.

##### What is your order processing time?

When you order packaging boxes or printing services, the team gets down to business. The turnaround
time is fast, and our team works tirelessly on the order’s processing. Within 10 to 12 working days,
we ship boxes to your doorstep. In some cases, businesses request instant delivery. So, we also have
a rapid delivery process through which we ship orders within a week.

##### Can I get a price quote for packaging boxes?

You can visit our website and go to the price quote section. You need to fill out a form and tell us
about your requirements. You need to select the packaging box type, cardstock, and quantity of boxes
required. There’s also a section where you will mention the box dimensions, and you can also give
special instructions. Our team will respond with a detailed price quote.

##### Do I have the option of Add-ons along with the packaging boxes?

There are numerous Add-on options, and you can get complete guidance from our packaging team. These
include custom inserts that come in various forms and colors. You can use them inside the packaging
to add grace and give extra cushion to items. Similarly, boxes with magnetic lids are available. You
can style them through finishing options like Spot UV, Glossy and Matte coating.

##### What payment methods are accepted?

We accept payment through MasterCard, Paypal, Visa, Discover Network, and American Express cards.
There is a secure SSL encrypted transaction, and your credit card details will remain confidential.

##### Should I pay extra for packaging design support?

No. You can consult our expert designers and get their valuable input without paying any cost. The
packaging design support service is free, and it comes with unlimited revisions. Professional
designers will guide you on the branding, styling, and appropriate printing of packaging.

##### What materials are used in the production of boxes?

We use top-notch raw materials in the manufacturing process. We craft packaging boxes with
cardboard, kraft, corrugated and rigid cardstock depending on the product’s nature. These are all
properly refined and pure, which adds more durability to boxes.

## Custom Printed Boxes on Wholesale Prices

**Premier Custom Boxes** is a famous name in the industry, and we offer bespoke custom packaging
services. With years of experience, we are famous in the industry for our unique **custom boxes with
logo **of all types. We have a state-of-the-art printing press for digital and offset printing
services that give wonderful print quality. Our team has a wide array of design options for all
types of product packaging boxes. You can access us for the best support because our team knows the
latest trends in packaging. So, we offer full liberty to choose the finishing options, designs, and
materials for their order. 

You can contact us for bespoke **custom made boxes** because we offer a huge variety of custom

industry, because we bring the right solution for your business products. So you will be the center
of all eyes due to the best boxes and their appearance.

Customization is the key to success, and we help you to personalize them in a way that can make your

Since we are available for our clients at affordable rates, you can access our team to meet the

custom labels, business cards, Kraft bags, brochures, and a variety of marketing products.

# Best Custom Packaging Boxes to Meet Market Challenges

Custom packaging has changed in previous years. In recent years, all businesses have needed the best

more exclusive in terms of display and presentation. So we use state-of-the-art printing effects and
methods for **custom boxes.** All retail businesses use high-end technologies to create a buzz for
their products, so some of the CB technologies are here that we use to make your brand more famous

* ### 3D Printing for Custom Boxes

We work for clients to surprise them. These days 3D printing technology takes the boxes of the world

* ### Die-Cut Technology

# Welcome to Sabert

Your trusted partner in sustainable and innovative food packaging solutions.

For more than 40 years, we've helped food distributors, restaurants, caterers, grocers, and national
chains deliver the food their customers love, with packaging that protects what's inside, performs
at the highest level, and meets you wherever you are on your sustainability journey.

*Engineered for what's next.* Our Centers for Innovation and an in-house product development team
push the boundaries of how food is packaged, protected, and served.

*Built across every substrate.* Advanced manufacturing across molded fiber, paper, and resin, backed
by 410+ active patents and a global footprint.

*Purpose that guides us.* Reinventing food packaging to nourish and protect our world.

Sci-Bot - answering questions based on research

Hear the good news: recent advances in artificial intelligence enabled Sci-Hub to launch a
[robot][2] that gives scientifically-grounded responses to questions. The robot starts with
searching for relevant literature in Sci-Hub database, then turns to selecting and reading most
recent studies, and composes the answer based on this information. The answer includes all the
references, and each referenced article can be read on Sci-Hub with one click.

Unlike question-answering robots that were based upon the early generation of neural networks,
Sci-Hub bot does not hallucinate and is not making up scientific facts and does not cite sources
that do not exist. To support its statements, Sci-Bot uses articles from Sci-Hub database. Questions
can be asked in any language, and answers can be saved on server and shared.

The alpha version only supports answerig one question, and a more advanced variation that supports
conversation mode is coming soon. Right column displays example questions that has been answered by
robot - push the question to see the generated answer.

[What is the current size of the Universe?][3]→
[To be or not to be?][4]→
[What is the most precise value for Pi number calculated to date?][5]→

# Where do I get new articles?

Sci-Hub coverage is larger than 90% for all papers published up to 2022 in major academic outlets.
Newer articles can be requested on a new platform [Sci-Net][6] which is a mutual-help social network
for researchers: you can post a request and it will be solved by other members. The fulltext
typically gets uploaded in a few minutes, except for some exotic cases. Once uploaded, the paper
remains free for everyone without registration. You can also upload your papers to ensure they will
be openly accessible forever.

The project uses Sci-Hub knowledge tokens to reward active members for helping build its open access
repository.

# database

Sci-Hub has the largest (> 88 million documents) database of full-text scientific papers, available
for free. Approximately 80% of the collection are articles from scientific journals, most of them
dedicated to the subject of medicine. That is followed by physics, chemistry and biology,
humanities, and etc. The entire collection is available for download on the [torrent network][7],
and takes up about 100 terabytes of space.
